times.source_text: The most adverse storms of the day were formed shortly after 14:00 hours. They were persistent and had torrential intensity until 20:00 hours, affecting towns in the regions of the Ribera Alta and the Hoya de Buñol.

times.source_text: From 20:00 hours the convective system (EP29-IV) moved to the north and began to affect regions and localities of the Turia valley.
